title: I never loved a dear gazelle but it was sure to
html_source:
I never nurs’d a dear gazelle
To glad me with its soft black eye,
But when it came to know me well
And love me, it was sure to die!
- From Lalla Rukh by Thomas Moore https://www.poetryfoundation.org/poems/44781/lalla-rookh
